description: A farm lane on a misty morning. A young woman with a long blond braid, a denim shirt, orange dungarees and yellow rubber boots walks towards the camera laughing, letting go of a metal gate as a long line of black-and-white cows follows her out past a barn. She pats a cow on the back as it walks by her. A black-and-white collie trots behind, milk churns stand against the barn wall, a milk tanker is parked further back and a young man in green overalls walks along the fence of a green field.

de.answer: Sie tätschelt einer Milchkuh den Rücken.
